name: skill-atlas
description: Map, categorize and search your installed Claude Code skill collection.

plugins.name: skill-atlas
plugins.description: Map, categorize and search every skill installed on your machine. Builds a graph of the whole collection — what is actually loadable, what is switched off, what points at things that no longer exist, what is duplicated — and renders it as a self-contained offline HTML atlas. Adds a third tier between enabled and disabled: 'searchable' skills cost zero tokens per session but stay findable through a two-stage catalog search, so a large collection stops competing for context.
